wwr.title: Beauty: Why prestige skincare keeps stealing share from masstige
wwr.body:
Prestige skincare gained +340bps of share over the past 18 months as consumers traded up at department stores and pharmacies. Implications for ELF, COTY, EL.

  • ELF: best-positioned at masstige price-points
  • EL: NA travel retail still soft

wwr.title: Off-mall apparel — traffic snapshot weekly update
wwr.body: Mall traffic -2.1% y/y in week ended Apr 21 vs off-mall +1.4%. Best-in-class: TJX, ROST, ANF outdoor.

wwr.title: Home improvement — pro vs DIY split deepening
wwr.body: HD pro segment up ~6%, DIY flat. LOW pro mix lighter. Watch SWK, MAS, FBHS print for confirmation.

wwo.title: PROJECT WHITE — prestige beauty carve-out
wwo.body: Diligence call set for Apr 30. Indicative bid window May 12-19. Latest model assumes 16-18x EV/EBITDA entry on $480M FY1 EBITDA.

wwo.title: PROJECT GRANITE — home improvement retail roll-up
wwo.body: Tracking 4 platform candidates. Trigger: 1Q26 print + comp guidance. No active process.

wwo.title: PROJECT IVORY — luxury accessories minority
wwo.body: Closed Mar 2026. Initial mark +3.2% over cost. Quarterly NAV update due.
